title: Apply review findings with a reconciled ledger
objective: The craftbook drives a real findings pass: three seeded review findings (unvalidated numeric input, a swallowed error, a misleading error message) read from an artifacts-drawer findings file, triaged against the current code, fixed at their actual sites, and verified per finding - with behavior probes proving each one genuinely closed and the neighborhood suite still green.
prompt: Use the Apply Review Findings craftbook: last week's code review left three findings in the artifacts drawer at reviews/findings.json. Triage them against the current code, fix what is real at the real sites, and account for every finding.

setup.about: A tiny order-intake library (quantity parsing, config loading, discounts). Tests run with `npm run test` (node --test).

files.content:
[
  {
    "id": "RV-1",
    "file": "src/quantity.js",
    "severity": "major",
    "title": "parseQuantity accepts invalid numeric input",
    "detail": "parseInt returns NaN for non-numeric input, and negative or zero values pass through unchecked, so downstream order math silently corrupts. parseQuantity must return only positive integers and throw a RangeError naming the rejected value for anything else.",
    "verify": "parseQuantity('abc'), parseQuantity('-2'), and parseQuantity('0') must throw; parseQuantity('3') must still return 3."
  },
  {
    "id": "RV-2",
    "file": "src/config.js",
    "severity": "major",
    "title": "loadConfig swallows JSON syntax errors",
    "detail": "The catch returns {} for every failure, so a corrupt config file silently behaves like an empty one and a bad deploy ships. Only a missing file may fall back to {}; a parse failure must propagate to the caller.",
    "verify": "loadConfig on a file containing invalid JSON must throw; loadConfig on a missing path must still return {}."
  },
  {
    "id": "RV-3",
    "file": "src/discount.js",
    "severity": "minor",
    "title": "applyDiscount raises a misleading error message",
    "detail": "An out-of-range percent raises 'quantity out of range', so support keeps chasing phantom quantity bugs. The message must describe the discount percent that was rejected.",
    "verify": "applyDiscount(100, 150) must throw with a message that mentions the discount or percent, not quantity."
  }
]

success.summary: All three seeded findings are genuinely closed at their real sites (validated quantity input, propagating config parse errors, an honest discount message), the neighborhood tests stay green, and the finding ids reconcile across triage, fix notes, and verification.

checks.label: the misleading discount message is gone (RV-3)
the blanket error swallow is gone (RV-2)

requiredOutput.label: corrupt configs raise, missing configs default (RV-2)
the discount error names the discount (RV-3)

checks.label: DONE note names the validation deliverable

axes.name: Triage honesty
axes.description: Every finding is judged against the code as it stands, with a defensible category and no invented or dropped findings.

axes.name: Real closure
axes.description: Each fix lands at the actual cited site and genuinely resolves what the finding describes - validation added, errors propagated, messages made truthful - with the smallest correct change.

axes.name: Ledger discipline
axes.description: The same finding ids flow through triage, fix notes, and verification with consistent outcomes, and verification honestly separates what was run from what was only read.
